chunks: And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said:
"Whoever sits in his place of prayer from the Fajr prayer until the rising of the sun, Allah will shield him from the Fire."

key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.سَتَرَهُ اللَّهُ: Allah will shield or cover him with protection
key_terms.صَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ: the Fajr prayer, the dawn salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for remaining seated after the Fajr prayer until sunrise?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages remaining in one's place of salat (prayer) after the Fajr prayer until sunrise. It describes this act of devotion as a cause for Allah's protection from the Fire, highlighting the spiritual merit of early morning worship and remembrance.
